input_state.U: all still-dynamic vertices X union Y
input_state.residual_components: all connected components C of G[Y0]
input_state.C0: every residual component has D_C!=empty and a compiled monotone message mu_C with MIN_BAD(C) of size <=6 plus stored witness colorings for allowed reachable masks

selector_construction.for_each: For every C and every M in MIN_BAD(C), create one virtual selector h_{C,M}.
selector_construction.outside_graph: Keep G[U] and its source list constraints exactly.

exact_semantics_target.local: For an outside coloring c, h_{C,M} is list-colorable iff M is not a subset of F_C(c).
exact_semantics_target.component: All selectors of C are simultaneously colorable iff mu_C(F_C(c))=1.
exact_semantics_target.global: An outside coloring extends through every original residual component iff it extends to every selector vertex.

reconstruction_target: Given a selector-graph coloring, ignore selector colors themselves.
For each C compute the actual nonempty F_C(c) from colors on D_C.
Use the C0 table to verify mu_C(F_C)=1 and fetch the stored explicit component-coloring witness.
Combine component witnesses; distinct Y0 components are anticomplete, X0 effects were already absorbed in B_C, seed is anticomplete to Y0.
size_target: At most 6 selector vertices per residual component, hence O(n) selectors total.

p7_target.relation_to_QALL: The selector graph is obtained from P7-free Q_ALL by deleting any component node with MIN_BAD(C)=empty and replacing every remaining [C] by an independent false-twin class indexed by MIN_BAD(C).
p7_target.theorem: Independent false-twin blowup preserves P7-freeness because an induced path on at least four vertices contains at most one vertex from one independent false-twin class; otherwise a twin-neighborhood chord is forced.

four_list_structure.fact: If [4] belongs to MIN_BAD(C), then MIN_BAD(C)={[4]} because MIN_BAD is an antichain and every other mask is a subset of [4].
four_list_structure.meaning: The only possible 4-list selector for a component is a single NO_ALL_FOUR_COLORS selector: it is colorable iff its neighborhood does not collectively use all four colors.

firewalls: Selector compilation is a normal-form theorem, not a solver.
Selectors may have different 3-lists among the four 3-subsets of [4], so P7-free List-3 on one common palette does not directly apply.
P7-free List-4 is not assumed tractable.
No semantic interpretation of source axioms (vi)-(viii) is promoted in this gate.
